Never its credentials. Needs `read`. post.description: Claims a `SimpleFin` setup token and stores the access it grants, sealed, as a new connection owned by the token's member; its first sync is queued. The claim URL must name an allowed bridge host: a setup token that is malformed, names another host or is refused by the bridge answers `422 setup_token_invalid`. Needs `write`; a token with account grants also needs `all` at `write`, since its first sync queues work on every account it reports. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry of the same request within 24 hours returns the first response instead of claiming again.

post.summary: Merges a duplicate into a transaction.
post.description: Merges `duplicate` into this transaction, both imported and of the same account: the duplicate's source records move here and the duplicate is deleted. This transaction keeps its notes, splits, review, assignee and payee, so choose the one holding them as the target; a pending target merged with a posted duplicate takes its posted fields. The duplicate's own user state is never combined: unless `discard_duplicate_state` is `true`, a duplicate that has any is refused with `merge_conflict`, and discarded values are recorded in the audit log. Its candidacies move here, and `possible_duplicate` clears once no candidate is left. Two transactions that each hold a posted record of the same connection are distinct purchases and are refused. Needs `write` on the account.

parameters.description: The transaction's id.

post.summary: Moves a source record into a transaction of its own.
post.description: Moves one of this transaction's source records into a new imported transaction of the same account, with the record's fields and no notes, splits, review, assignee or flags. This transaction keeps its user state and shows the fields of its remaining records; a single split follows a new amount. Later syncs keep them apart. Needs `write` on the account. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry of the same request within 24 hours returns the first response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters naming this request, unique per member for 24 hours.

201.description: The new transaction, created now or by an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.
